ASSIGNMENTOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS 2015, is entered into by and between (a) BPP ST Owner LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address of c/o Blackstone Property Advisors L.P., 345 Park Avenue, New York, New York 10154 (Assignor"), and (b) BPP STAR LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address of c/o Blackstone Property Advisors L.P., 345 Park Avenue, New York, New York 10154 ("Assignee"). BACKGROUND A. Assignor is the owner of fee simple title to certain real property and the improvements located thereon, which are the multi-family properties commonly known as Stuyvesant Town located in New York City, designated as Block 972, Lot 1 (the “ST Lot"), and more particularly described on Exhibit A hereto (the “Real Property"). Assignor also is the owner of any floor area development rights appurtenant to the RealProperty in excess of the floor area development rights utilized by the improvements at the Real Property on the date hereof, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork,effective December 15,1961,as amended from time to time (the “Excess Air Rights"). B.Pursuant to the Amended and Restated Limited Liability Company Agreement by and Agreement) and Assignee is the sole equity memberof SeriesB (as defined in the Operating Agreement). C. Pursuant to the Operating Agreement, the Interests designated as “Real Estate Series A Interests"” represent the fee simple title to the Real Property, along with 250,000 square feet of Excess Air Rights (limited to a maximum of 200,000 square feet of floor area for community facility use, a maximumof25,000squarefeetoffloorareaforresidentialuse,andamaximumof25,000squarefeetof floor area for commercial use), and the Interests designated as“FAR Series B Interests”represent title to the remainingExcess Air Rights("Remaining ExcessAirRights"). D. In furtherance of the foregoing, Assignor desires to transfer to Assignee, and Assignee desires to accept, the Remaining Excess Air Rights. NOW, THEREFORE, the parties do hereby covenant and agree as follows and take the following actions: 1. Assignor does hereby transfer and assign to Assignee, and Assignee hereby accepts, in Assignor, all of Assignor's right, title and interest in and to the Remaining Excess Air Rights. 2.THE REMAINING EXCESS AIR RIGHTS ARE BEING TRANSFERRED “AS IS", "WHEREIS", AND “WITH ALLFAULTS"AS OF THE DATE OF THIS ASSIGNMENT, WITHOUT OTHER WARRANTY,EXPRESS OR IMPLIED.ASSIGNOR SPECIFICALLY DISCLAIMS ANY WARRANTY,GUARANTY ORREPRESENTATION,ORAL OR WRITTEN,PAST OR PRESENT, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, CONCERNING THE REMAINING EXCESS AIR RIGHTS OR EXCESSAIR RIGHTS BASEDSOLELYUPONASSIGNEE'S OWNINDEPENDENT INVESTIGATIONSANDINSPECTIONSOFTHEREALPROPERTYANDTHEEXCESSAIR

ASSIGNOR'SAGENTSORCONTRACTORS. 3. Notice is hereby given that thisAssignment irrevocably restricts the available floor area and development rights on the Real Property to the sum of (i) those rights utilized by the improvements at the Real Property on the date hereof and (i) an additional 250,000 square feet of floor area development rights(limited to 200,000 square feet of floor area for communityfacility use, 25,000 square feet of floor area for residential use, and 25,000 square feet of floor area for commercial use). 4. This Assignment shall be (a) binding upon, and inure to the benefit of, the parties to this Assignment and their respective heirs, legal representatives, successors and assigns, and (b) construed in accordance with the laws of the State of NewYork, without regard to the application of choice of law [SignaturePagesFollow]
